summary: Mathlib finite union plus accessibility induction proves finite distinct ancestry from well-foundedness and finite immediate causal fan-in; separate Lean witnesses refute either assumption's sufficiency in isolation. A prior #367 result supplies the converse with cycle-exclusion under finite fan-in. The result does not justify the premises in physical, per se, temporal, or modal applications. See docs/causal-finite-branching-and-psr-syllogisms.md.
